The '''Production Advocate''' is the [[Players Committee]] advocate for production: overseeing Player Card Development, preparing the PDF files for new virtual cards, arranging cosplay art for them, and making logos, banners and promotional materials. On the current chart the Production Advocate is over Player Card Development and Graphics.<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (Wayback copy of 10 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF])</ref> The current Production Advocate is [[Mike Kessling]].

To contact the Players Committee, see the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/contact/ Contact page] on starwarsccg.org.
